description: Clinical dictation, occult infection versus lymphoma. The recorded ASR output is SYNTHETIC and carries two more real Whisper failure classes: a clinically dangerous homophone split ('occult' -> 'a cult', which changes the meaning of the sentence entirely) and lab acronyms spelled out letter by letter ('ESR' -> 'E S R', 'CRP' -> 'C R P'). Nothing here came from a live model. Note that 'contrast-enhanced' versus 'contrast enhanced' scores NO error, because WER normalization treats a hyphen as a word separator -- they really are the same two words.
text: Persistent fever with unexplained weight loss raises concern for a cult infection or lymphoma. Request complete blood count, E S R, C R P, blood cultures, and contrast enhanced CT imaging.
